editorial.blurb: Alem Ethiopian Village is a warm, culturally immersive dining experience where generous portions of boldly flavored traditional dishes and attentive service make every first-timer and returning guest feel welcome.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early in the evening to avoid the crowds—the word is clearly out about this place, and the vegetarian combo platter offers exceptional value and variety for sharing.

topDishes.note: a big platter of delicious, flavorful dishes with perfect seasoning
